radiocarbonReference.title: Radiocarbon dating of terrestrial carbonates
radiocarbonReference.independentParaphrase: The USGS describes suitable terrestrial carbonate materials, including tufa, speleothems and some secondary carbonates. Organic material is therefore not universally necessary for radiocarbon dating. Reservoir, disequilibrium and open-system issues determine reliability. The million-year-old ash exclusion remains correct.
